svg.title: Requirement map of WP-S-02
svg.desc: One row per safety function plus the common and security blocks; each requirement is a chip coloured by its type; dashed chips apply only to the 2.0 configuration; dotted chips carry a value to be confirmed.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 18-1 Requirement map: 82 requirements, SR-00 to SR-90

svg.text: One chip per requirement, coloured by type; a dashed border marks the 20 CFG-002-only requirements, a dot the 18 with a value to be confirmed
